meta.title: Knockout (rounds) auction: what each side sees during bidding
gaps: Create a fresh auction using the knockout (rounds) strategy; knockout is only supported through RFQ-to-Auction conversion and no catalog step performs that conversion with knockout configuration.
Run knockout auction rounds and cause the worst vendor to be knocked out.
Observe the buyer's Responses during knockout rounds.
Observe Vendor A's and Vendor B's bidding screens in separate vendor sessions.
Verify that only qualified vendors can bid in the next round.
Verify that the knocked-out vendor sees that it is out.
